text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Transport Minister Joe Debono Grech publishes report on Malta-Gozo ferry company which says line is "technically insolvent" after suffering mismanagement under former government. The state-owned company enjoys a monopoly in ferry services to Malta's sister island of Gozo.
- Finance Minister Leo Brincat has ordered an inquiry into how government workers received reduced pay cheques after a new computerised system was introduced.
- Construction industry sees fall in workload.
